Track how many times in a row the same type of error has occurred:

Before calling submit_result, STOP and explicitly verify each item below. If ANY item fails, run a corrective query FIRST and only then submit.

Now I'll calculate the average of total runs scored by strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match. Let me break this down into steps:

1. First, identify strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match
2. Then calculate the total runs for each such striker across all matches
3. Finally, calculate the average of these total runs

args.sql:
WITH strikers_with_50plus AS (
    -- Find strikers who scored more than 50 runs in any single match
    SELECT 
        striker,
        SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored s ON b.match_id = s.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = s.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
    GROUP BY striker, b.match_id
    HAVING SUM(runs_scored) > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
    -- Calculate total runs for each striker who met the 50+ criteria
    SELECT 
        striker,
        SUM(match_runs) as total_runs
    FROM strikers_with_50plus
    GROUP BY striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_totals;
